definition: Advanced Automatic Collision Notification uses vehicle crash sensors and telematics to transmit crash information for emergency response and may estimate injury risk from the transmitted data.
entry_text: Advanced Automatic Collision Notification uses vehicle crash sensors and telematics to transmit crash information for emergency response and may estimate injury risk from the transmitted data.
example: A response center receives the location and severity indicators after a crash even though the occupants cannot call for help.
label: Advanced Automatic Collision Notification
